subject: RLA
skillLabel: Telling a claim apart from its supporting evidence
stimulus: A city planner writes: "Our downtown parking garages sit half-empty on weekdays while street parking overflows. Converting one garage floor to bike storage would ease congestion without losing much parking capacity."
question: Which sentence from the passage is the actual claim being argued?
options: Converting one garage floor to bike storage would ease congestion without losing much parking capacity
Downtown parking garages sit half-empty on weekdays
Congestion is a problem in every downtown

misconceptionNotes.1: picked a supporting detail (the empty garages) instead of the claim itself
misconceptionNotes.2: picked a supporting detail (overflowing street parking) instead of the claim itself
misconceptionNotes.3: picked a broad idea the passage never actually states

subject: RLA

subject: RLA
